headline: Healthy operational performance; outlook strong

highlights: Management stated that retail segment’s demand improved, while the project segment remained healthy.
CRS has maintained its revenue growth guidance of 18–20% and 13–14% OPM for FY27.
We expect CRS to continue reporting strong revenue growth due to volume traction and partly due to price hikes.
OPM is expected to improve as RM inflation is passed on and price hikes in OEMs (~40% of revenues) possibly start from Q3.
